The name "Mercedes" was later incorporated into the "Mercedes-Benz" brand in 1926 after the merger of DMG and Benz & Cie.

cases.agent_final_answer:
**Answer:**

The constructor with the highest points is **Ferrari**. Summing points from `constructorResults` (joined to `constructors`), Ferrari leads with **7,081.5 points**, ahead of McLaren (5,232.5), Red Bull (3,750.5), Williams (3,541.0), and Mercedes (3,525.0).

**Origin of the name:** The Ferrari automotive brand is named after its founder, **Enzo Ferrari**. According to the retrieved source (ctx://team/engineering/hydra/kilt/11225/0000, v1), "Ferrari is an Italian luxury sports car manufacturer based in Maranello. Founded by Enzo Ferrari in 1939 out of Alfa Romeo's race division as 'Auto Avio Costruzioni', the company built its first car in 1940," with the company's inception as an auto manufacturer usually recognized in 1947 "when the first Ferrari-badged car was completed." A related passage (ctx://team/engineering/hydra/kilt/11225/0002, v1) notes that when Enzo Ferrari left Alfa Romeo in September 1939, he was barred from using the Ferrari name on racing cars for four years, and his racing team name "Scuderia Ferrari" was later resurrected to denote the factory racing cars (ctx://team/engineering/hydra/kilt/11225/0004, v1).

So the constructor's name comes directly from founder Enzo Ferrari's surname, with "Scuderia Ferrari" (Italian for "Ferrari stable/team") denoting the racing division.

mercedes_race_and_standing_samples.sql: SELECT r.year,r.round,cr.points AS race_points,cs.points AS standing_points FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId=cs.constructorId JOIN races r ON r.raceId=cs.raceId LEFT JOIN constructorResults cr ON cr.raceId=cs.raceId AND cr.constructorId=cs.constructorId WHERE c.name='Mercedes' AND r.year=2016 AND r.round IN (1,2,20,21) ORDER BY r.round

mercedes_2016_sum.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS races,SUM(cr.points) AS points FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId=cr.constructorId JOIN races r ON r.raceId=cr.raceId WHERE c.name='Mercedes' AND r.year=2016

irvine_2000_rounds.sql: SELECT r.round,r.name,rr.points AS race_points,ds.points AS standing_points FROM races r LEFT JOIN results rr ON rr.raceId=r.raceId AND rr.driverId=(SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename='Eddie' AND surname='Irvine') LEFT JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId=r.raceId AND ds.driverId=(SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename='Eddie' AND surname='Irvine') WHERE r.year=2000 ORDER BY r.round
